name: YMCA of Central Massachusetts Camps (multi-branch overview)
description_short: This is the YMCA of Central Massachusetts overview page for its day camps at several branches: Boroughs, Camp Blanchard and Alden in the Worcester area, Camp Greendale on Indian Lake, and Camp Lowe. Programs include general day camp, preschool camp, sports, karate, tennis and teen leadership/CIT tracks. Most run in one-week sessions, and several offer extended care from 7:30 am to 6:00 pm.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp Blanchard is an outdoor day camp on Lake Manchaug (208 Manchaug Road, Sutton, MA). Camp Greendale is on Indian Lake. The Boroughs branch offers a lifeguard/swim instructor training track for teens entering high school. The page does not describe swim instruction or waterfront supervision.

This is an overview page for several camps run by different YMCA branches (Camp Boroughs, Camp Blanchard, Alden Summer Program, Camp Greendale on Indian Lake, Camp Lowe). It is not one camp, and each camp has its own director, location and ages.

Ages vary by program, from 2.9 years (Greendale Pre School Camp) to 17 (Camp Greendale). Grades range from entering 1st to 7th (Blanchard/Alden) up to teens entering high school. Overall age/grade fields were left blank.
The only price stated is Boroughs transportation at $40/week. No tuition is listed anywhere.
Contact emails are hidden on the page ('[email protected]'). Greendale phone numbers have no area code.
A Y-Access Pricing / Financial Assistance link exists in the site menu, but it is listed under membership. The page does not say whether it applies to camp.
